<li>示例：<code>history.replace('/new-page')</code></li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-86">73. 如何在 React Router 中编程式导航？</h4>
<p>在 React Router v6 中，你可以通过使用 <code>useNavigate</code> hook 进行编程式导航。首先从 <code>react-router-dom</code> 导入 <code>useNavigate</code> 并调用它获取 navigate 函数。然后可以使用 <code>navigate('/new-page')</code> 导航到不同路由。</p>
<p>例如：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useNavigate } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> navigate = <span class="hljs-title function_">useNavigate</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">goToPage</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">navigate</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/new-page'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{goToPage}</span>&gt;</span>Go to New Page<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>在 React Router v5 中，<code>useHistory</code> hook 提供对 history 对象的访问，你可以使用它来 push 新路由。例如，<code>history.push('/new-page')</code> 将导航到指定路由。</p>
<p>例如：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useHistory } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> history = <span class="hljs-title function_">useHistory</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">goToPage</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; history.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/new-page'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{goToPage}</span>&gt;</span>Go to New Page<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>两种方法都允许你在 React Router 中编程式导航。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-87">74. 如何在 React 中实现路由守卫或私有路由？</h4>
<p>要实现私有路由，创建一个在渲染目标路由之前检查用户是否已认证的组件。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Navigate</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">PrivateRoute</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ children }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> isAuthenticated ? children : <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Navigate</span> <span class="hljs-attr">to</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/login"</span> /&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>PrivateRoute</code>：检查认证状态，要么渲染 children（受保护路由），要么重定向到登录页面。</li>
<li><code>&lt;Navigate&gt;</code>：替代 React Router v6+ 中已弃用的 <code>&lt;Redirect&gt;</code> 用于重定向。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-88">75. 如何在多页 React 应用中管理活跃路由状态？</h4>
<p>使用 useLocation hook 获取当前路由，并条件性地应用活跃状态的样式。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useLocation } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">NavBar</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> location = <span class="hljs-title function_">useLocation</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">nav</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ul</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">li</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{location.pathname</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'/home'</span> ? '<span class="hljs-attr">active</span>' <span class="hljs-attr">:</span> ''}&gt;</span>Home<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">li</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">li</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{location.pathname</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'/about'</span> ? '<span class="hljs-attr">active</span>' <span class="hljs-attr">:</span> ''}&gt;</span>
          About
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">li</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">ul</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">nav</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-89">76. 如何在 React Router 中处理 404 错误或页面未找到？</h4>
<p>要在 React Router 中处理 404 错误或页面未找到，在路由配置末尾创建一个通配路由，渲染自定义 404 组件。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Routes</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Route</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">NotFound</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">h1</span>&gt;</span>404 - Page Not Found<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">h1</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">Home</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/about"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">About</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"*"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">NotFound</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，当没有其他路由匹配 URL 时，<code>NotFound</code> 组件被渲染，表示 404 错误。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-90">77. 如何在 React Router 中获取查询参数？</h4>
<p>在 React Router v6 中，可以使用 <code>useSearchParams</code> hook 从 URL 中访问查询参数。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useSearchParams } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [searchParams] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useSearchParams</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> queryParam = searchParams.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'paramName'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>Query Param: {queryParam}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>此 hook 允许你在 React Router v6 中检索和操作查询参数。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-91">78. 如何在 React Router 中登录后自动重定向？</h4>
<p>要在 React Router 中登录后自动重定向，使用 <code>useNavigate</code> hook 在成功认证后导航到目标路由。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useNavigate } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Login</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> navigate = <span class="hljs-title function_">useNavigate</span>();

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleLogin</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// Perform login logic</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">navigate</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/dashboard'</span>);
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleLogin}</span>&gt;</span>Login<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，<code>handleLogin</code> 函数在成功登录后导航到 <code>/dashboard</code> 路由。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-92">79. 如何在 React Router 中向路由组件传递 props？</h4>
<p>在 React Router v6 中，可以使用 <code>&lt;Route&gt;</code> 组件的 <code>element</code> prop 向路由组件传递 props。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Routes</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Route</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ propValue }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>Prop Value: {propValue}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/my-route"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-attr">propValue</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Hello"</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，渲染 <code>/my-route</code> 路由时将 <code>propValue</code> prop 传递给了 <code>MyComponent</code> 组件。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-93">React 国际化</h3>
<p>理解 React 中的国际化（i18n）在前端面试中很重要，因为许多产品服务全球受众，必须支持多种语言和区域设置。展示你可以实现 i18n 表明你关注无障碍访问、用户体验，并准备好为多样化用户构建应用。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-94">80. 如何本地化 React 应用？</h4>
<p>本地化通常涉及 react-i18next 或 react-intl 等库。为不同语言设置翻译文件，并使用提供的 hooks 或组件在应用中配置这些库。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// Example using react-i18next</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useTranslation } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-i18next'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { t } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTranslation</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span>{t('welcome_message')}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span></span>;
};
</code></pre>
<p><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatfrontend.com%2Fquestions%2Fquiz%2Fhow-do-you-localize-react-applications" target="_blank" title="https://www.greatfrontend.com/questions/quiz/how-do-you-localize-react-applications" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">查看详细解释并跟踪学习进度 -&gt;</a></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-95">81. 什么是 <code>react-intl</code>？</h4>
<p><code>react-intl</code> 是一个为 React 应用提供国际化（i18n）支持的库。它帮助格式化数字、日期、字符串，并处理翻译/本地化。它与 JavaScript 的 <code>Intl</code> API 集成，提供区域特定的数据和翻译管理。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-96">82. <code>react-intl</code> 的主要特性有哪些？</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>格式化文本</strong>：帮助使用占位符格式化消息和字符串。</li>
<li><strong>数字格式化</strong>：允许根据区域设置格式化数字、货币和百分比。</li>
<li><strong>日期和时间格式化</strong>：帮助根据区域设置以各种格式格式化日期和时间。</li>
<li><strong>复数和性别支持</strong>：提供复数形式和性别感知的字符串格式化。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-97">83. <code>react-intl</code> 中有哪两种格式化方式？</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>基于组件的格式化</strong>：使用 React 组件如 <code>&lt;FormattedMessage /&gt;</code>、<code>&lt;FormattedNumber /&gt;</code>、<code>&lt;FormattedDate /&gt;</code> 等来格式化内容。</li>
<li><strong>基于 Hook 的格式化</strong>：使用 <code>useIntl</code> 等 hooks 在组件内部以命令式方式格式化消息、数字或日期。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-98">84. 如何在 <code>react-intl</code> 中使用 <code>FormattedMessage</code> 作为占位符？</h4>
<p>你可以使用 <code>FormattedMessage</code> 组件来处理字符串中的占位符。占位符会被翻译后字符串中的变量动态替换。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">FormattedMessage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-intl'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">WelcomeMessage</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">FormattedMessage</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"welcome"</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">defaultMessage</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Hello, {name}!"</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">values</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span> <span class="hljs-attr">name:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">John</span>' }}
    /&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>这里 <code>{name}</code> 是一个占位符，<code>John</code> 会替换它。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-99">85. 如何使用 React Intl 访问当前 locale？</h4>
<p>你可以使用 <code>useIntl</code> hook 或 <code>IntlProvider</code> 的 <code>locale</code> prop 访问当前 locale。</p>
<p>使用 <code>useIntl</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useIntl } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-intl'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">LocaleDisplay</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> intl = <span class="hljs-title function_">useIntl</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>Current locale: {intl.locale}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <code>IntlProvider</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx">&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">IntlProvider</span> locale=<span class="hljs-string">"en"</span> messages={messages}&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/<span class="hljs-title class_">IntlProvider</span>&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>这里 <code>locale="en"</code> 定义了当前 locale。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-100">86. 如何使用 <code>react-intl</code> 格式化日期？</h4>
<p>你可以使用 <code>&lt;FormattedDate /&gt;</code> 组件或 <code>useIntl</code> hook 的 <code>formatDate</code> 方法来格式化日期。</p>
<p>使用 <code>&lt;FormattedDate /&gt;</code> 组件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">FormattedDate</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-intl'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">DateComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">FormattedDate</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{new</span> <span class="hljs-attr">Date</span>()}
      <span class="hljs-attr">year</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"numeric"</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">month</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"long"</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">day</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"2-digit"</span>
    /&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <code>useIntl</code> hook：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useIntl } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-intl'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">DateComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> intl = <span class="hljs-title function_">useIntl</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formattedDate = intl.<span class="hljs-title function_">formatDate</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>(), {
    <span class="hljs-attr">year</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'numeric'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">month</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'long'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">day</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'2-digit'</span>,
  });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>{formattedDate}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>这些方法允许你以区域敏感的方式格式化日期。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-101">React 测试</h3>
<p>理解 React 中的测试在前端面试中很重要，因为这表明你可以编写可靠、可维护的代码，并通过单元测试、集成测试和 UI 测试及早发现 bug。熟练使用 Jest 和 React Testing Library 等工具表明你重视代码质量，能够在具有 CI/CD 工作流的团队环境中有效工作。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-102">87. 如何测试 React 应用？</h4>
<p>测试 React 应用可以使用 Jest 和 React Testing Library。Jest 作为测试框架，React Testing Library 提供以类似于用户交互的方式测试组件的工具。</p>
<p><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatfrontend.com%2Fquestions%2Fquiz%2Fhow-do-you-test-react-applications" target="_blank" title="https://www.greatfrontend.com/questions/quiz/how-do-you-test-react-applications" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">查看详细解释并跟踪学习进度 -&gt;</a></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-103">88. 什么是 Jest？它如何用于测试 React 应用？</h4>
<p>Jest 是一个 JavaScript 测试框架，提供测试运行器、断言库和 mock 支持。由于其简洁性以及与 React Testing Library 等工具的集成，它通常用于测试 React 应用。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-104">89. 什么是 React Testing Library？它如何用于测试 React 组件？</h4>
<p>React Testing Library 是 React 的一个测试工具，帮助以类似于用户与应用交互的方式测试组件。它提供渲染组件、与组件交互以及对渲染输出进行断言的功能。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-105">90. 如何使用 React Testing Library 测试 React 组件？</h4>
<p>要使用 React Testing Library 测试 React 组件，你可以：</p>
<ol>
<li>使用 <code>render</code> 渲染组件。</li>
<li>与组件交互（如点击按钮、输入文本）。</li>
<li>使用 <code>getByText</code>、<code>queryByRole</code> 等查询对渲染输出进行断言。</li>
</ol>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render, screen, fireEvent } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renders component'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> button = screen.<span class="hljs-title function_">getByRole</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'button'</span>);
  fireEvent.<span class="hljs-title function_">click</span>(button);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(screen.<span class="hljs-title function_">getByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Clicked!'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，测试渲染 <code>MyComponent</code>，点击按钮，并断言文本 'Clicked!' 存在。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-106">91. 如何测试 React 组件中的异步代码？</h4>
<p>要测试 React 组件中的异步代码，可以使用 <code>async/await</code> 配合 React Testing Library 的 <code>waitFor</code> 来处理数据获取或 API 调用等异步操作。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render, screen, waitFor } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'fetches data and renders it'</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">waitFor</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(screen.<span class="hljs-title function_">getByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Data loaded'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
  });
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，测试等待数据加载完毕后再断言文本 'Data loaded' 存在。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-107">92. 如何在 React 组件测试中 mock API 调用？</h4>
<p>要在 React 组件测试中 mock API 调用，可以使用 Jest 的 <code>jest.mock</code> 来 mock API 模块并返回 mock 数据。这允许你在不进行实际网络请求的情况下模拟 API 响应。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render, screen } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;

jest.<span class="hljs-title function_">mock</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./api'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> ({
  <span class="hljs-attr">fetchData</span>: jest.<span class="hljs-title function_">fn</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'mocked data'</span>)),
}));

<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'fetches data and renders it'</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(screen.<span class="hljs-title function_">getByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Loading...'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> screen.<span class="hljs-title function_">findByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'mocked data'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，<code>api</code> 模块中的 <code>fetchData</code> 函数被 mock 为返回 'mocked data' 用于测试目的。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-108">93. 如何测试函数组件中的 React hooks？</h4>
<p>使用 <code>@testing-library/react</code> 中的 <code>renderHook</code> 在测试中渲染 hook，然后调用 <code>act</code> 来驱动任何 state 更新。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { renderHook, act } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> useCounter <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./useCounter'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'increments counter'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { result } = <span class="hljs-title function_">renderHook</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useCounter</span>());
  <span class="hljs-title function_">act</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    result.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">increment</span>();
  });
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(result.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBe</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
});
</code></pre>
<p>旧资料从 <code>@testing-library/react-hooks</code> 导入 <code>renderHook</code>。该包已被弃用并在 v13 中合并到 <code>@testing-library/react</code>；请使用上面展示的导入方式。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-109">94. 如何测试 React 中的自定义 hooks？</h4>
<p>方法与上述相同：使用 <code>renderHook</code> 渲染 hook 并对 <code>result.current</code> 进行断言。对于依赖 context 的 hooks（如 router 或 theme provider），传递 <code>wrapper</code> 选项。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { renderHook, act } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> useCustomHook <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./useCustomHook'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hook behavior'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { result } = <span class="hljs-title function_">renderHook</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useCustomHook</span>());
  <span class="hljs-title function_">act</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    result.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">doSomething</span>();
  });
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(result.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBe</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'expected value'</span>);
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// With a context provider:</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">wrapper</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">{ children }</span>) =&gt; (
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyProvider</span> <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"test"</span>&gt;</span>{children}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">MyProvider</span>&gt;</span></span>
);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { result } = <span class="hljs-title function_">renderHook</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useCustomHook</span>(), { wrapper });
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-110">95. React 测试中的 Shallow Renderer 是什么？</h4>
<p>Shallow rendering 仅渲染组件一层深度：其子组件不会被渲染，仅作为 React elements 被引用。目的是将测试中的组件与其子组件隔离开来。</p>
<p>有两种实现：<code>react-test-renderer/shallow</code>（低级 API）和 Enzyme 的 <code>shallow()</code>（围绕它的流行封装）。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// Enzyme-style example (historical)</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { shallow } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'enzyme'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wrapper = <span class="hljs-title function_">shallow</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Click Me"</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
<span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(wrapper.<span class="hljs-title function_">text</span>()).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBe</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Click Me'</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>不要在新代码中使用 shallow rendering。Enzyme 已无人维护，且没有官方的 React 17+ 适配器。React 文档推荐使用 React Testing Library，它以用户看到的方式渲染组件并基于可访问的输出进行断言，因此测试不会因内部重构而失效。改用 RTL 的 <code>render</code> 配合 <code>screen.getByRole</code> / <code>getByText</code>。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-111">96. React 中的 Snapshot Testing 是什么？</h4>
<p>React 中的 Snapshot Testing 是一种测试技术，用于捕获组件的渲染输出并将其保存为快照。后续的测试运行会将当前输出与保存的快照进行比较，以检测任何意外变化。如果输出与快照不同，测试失败，表明组件的输出发生了变化。</p>
<p>以下是使用 Jest 进行 Snapshot Testing 的示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> renderer <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-test-renderer'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renders correctly'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tree = renderer.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">toJSON</span>();
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(tree).<span class="hljs-title function_">toMatchSnapshot</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，<code>renderer.create</code> 函数渲染 <code>MyComponent</code> 并将其转换为 JSON 树。<code>toMatchSnapshot</code> 函数保存组件输出的快照。后续测试运行将当前输出与保存的快照进行比较，确保组件的输出保持一致。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-112">97. 如何测试使用 context 的 React 组件？</h4>
<p>要测试使用 context 的 React 组件，可以用带有测试所需 context 值的 context provider 包裹组件。这允许你模拟 context 值并根据这些值测试组件的行为。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">MyContextProvider</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyContextProvider'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renders correctly with context'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { getByText } = <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyContextProvider</span> <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"test value"</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">MyContextProvider</span>&gt;</span></span>,
  );
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'test value'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，<code>MyComponent</code> 被包裹在带有特定 context 值的 <code>MyContextProvider</code> 中用于测试。测试验证组件使用提供的 context 值正确渲染。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-113">98. 如何测试使用 Redux 的 React 组件？</h4>
<p>要测试使用 Redux 的 React 组件，可以使用 <code>redux-mock-store</code> 库创建一个带有目标 state 的 mock store 用于测试。这允许你模拟 Redux store 并根据该 state 测试组件的行为。</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> configureStore <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'redux-mock-store'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Provider</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-redux'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mockStore = <span class="hljs-title function_">configureStore</span>([]);

<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'renders correctly with Redux state'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> store = <span class="hljs-title function_">mockStore</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">counter</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span> });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { getByText } = <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Provider</span> <span class="hljs-attr">store</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{store}</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Provider</span>&gt;</span></span>,
  );
  <span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getByText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Counter: 0'</span>)).<span class="hljs-title function_">toBeInTheDocument</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<p>在此示例中，<code>MyComponent</code> 被包裹在 <code>Provider</code> 中，带有一个包含初始 state <code>{ counter: 0 }</code> 的 mock Redux store 用于测试。测试验证组件使用提供的 Redux state 正确渲染。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-114">99. React 测试中 Shallow Rendering 和 Full DOM Rendering 的关键区别是什么？</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Shallow Rendering</strong>：仅渲染被测试的组件，不渲染其子组件。适用于独立的单元测试。</li>
<li><strong>Full DOM Rendering</strong>：挂载整个组件树，包括子组件，提供完整的 DOM 结构。适用于集成测试。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-115">100. React 中的 TestRenderer 包是什么？</h4>
<p><code>react-test-renderer</code> 是一个将 React 组件渲染为纯 JS 对象树（而非 DOM）的工具，适用于无需浏览器环境的快照测试。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">TestRenderer</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-test-renderer'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyComponent</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./MyComponent'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> renderer = <span class="hljs-title class_">TestRenderer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">create</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tree = renderer.<span class="hljs-title function_">toJSON</span>();
<span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(tree).<span class="hljs-title function_">toMatchSnapshot</span>();
</code></pre>
<p><code>react-test-renderer</code> 自 React 19 起已弃用，React 团队建议迁移。对于组件测试，使用 React Testing Library 配合 DOM 环境（Jest 使用 <code>jsdom</code>，Vitest 内置）。对于快照测试，序列化 RTL 的 <code>render</code> 产生的 DOM：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { render } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@testing-library/react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { container } = <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">MyComponent</span> /&gt;</span></span>);
<span class="hljs-title function_">expect</span>(container).<span class="hljs-title function_">toMatchSnapshot</span>();
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-116">React 19 与现代 React</h3>
<p>React 19 增加了 Actions 和表单集成、<code>use</code> hook、稳定的 Server Components 以及 React Compiler。这些是 2026 年常见的面试话题。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-117">101. React 19 有哪些新特性？</h4>
<p>React 19 增加：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Actions</strong>：包装异步工作的函数，通过新的 hooks 产生 pending/error/data 状态。</li>
<li><strong><code>use</code> hook</strong>：在渲染期间读取 Promise 和 context。</li>
<li>稳定的 <strong>React Server Components</strong> 和 <strong>Server Actions</strong>。</li>
<li>原生支持 <code>&lt;form action={fn}&gt;</code>。</li>
<li>函数组件上 <code>ref</code> 作为常规 prop（不再需要 <code>forwardRef</code>）。</li>
<li>JSX 中 <code>&lt;title&gt;</code>、<code>&lt;meta&gt;</code> 和样式表的提升。</li>
<li><strong>React Compiler</strong>：一个可选加入的构建时优化器，自动进行 memoization。</li>
</ul>
<p>这些共同将数据变更和异步 UI 状态移入 React 本身，而不是让每个应用自行实现这些模式。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-118">102. React 19 中的 Actions 是什么？</h4>
<p>按照惯例，Action 是一个传递给 React API 的异步函数，React 在 transition 中运行它：<code>useActionState</code>、<code>startTransition</code>（来自 <code>useTransition</code>）或 <code>&lt;form action={...}&gt;</code> prop。React 跟踪 pending 状态、暴露错误，并在 transition 中应用更新，使 UI 保持响应。这消除了切换 loading 标志、包裹 try/catch 以及分别管理 error 和 data 状态的常见模板代码。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useActionState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateName</span>(<span class="hljs-params">prevState, formData</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> name = formData.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'name'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> error = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">saveName</span>(name);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (error) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { error };
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { name };
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">NameForm</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [state, dispatchAction, isPending] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useActionState</span>(updateName, {
    <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
  });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">form</span> <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{dispatchAction}</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">input</span> <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"name"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">defaultValue</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{state.name}</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">disabled</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{isPending}</span>&gt;</span>Save<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span>
      {state.error &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span>{state.error}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span>}
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">form</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-119">103. <code>useActionState</code> hook 的作用是什么？</h4>
<p><code>useActionState</code> 接收一个 action 函数和一个初始 state，返回 <code>[state, dispatchAction, isPending]</code>。调用 <code>dispatchAction</code>（通常通过将其传递给 <code>&lt;form action&gt;</code>）会运行 action，将 <code>isPending</code> 标记为 true，并在 action resolve 后用返回值替换 state。一个 hook 覆盖了原本需要三个独立 <code>useState</code> 调用来分别管理 data、loading 和 error 的逻辑。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-120">104. <code>useOptimistic</code> 的作用是什么？</h4>
<p><code>useOptimistic</code> 在 action 执行期间立即渲染乐观版本的 state，然后在 action 完成后自动恢复到真实 state。适用于聊天消息、点赞、列表重排序，或任何网络往返会感觉延迟的场景。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useOptimistic } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MessageList</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ messages, sendMessage }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [optimisticMessages, addOptimistic] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useOptimistic</span>(
    messages,
    <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state, newMessage</span>) =&gt;</span> [...state, { <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: newMessage, <span class="hljs-attr">sending</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> }],
  );

  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSend</span>(<span class="hljs-params">formData</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> text = formData.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'text'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">addOptimistic</span>(text);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sendMessage</span>(text);
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      {optimisticMessages.map((m, i) =&gt; (
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">p</span> <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{i}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span> <span class="hljs-attr">opacity:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">m.sending</span> ? <span class="hljs-attr">0.5</span> <span class="hljs-attr">:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">1</span> }}&gt;</span>
          {m.text}
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span>
      ))}
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">form</span> <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleSend}</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">input</span> <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"text"</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">form</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-121">105. <code>use</code> hook 是什么？它与 <code>useEffect</code> + fetch 有何不同？</h4>
<p><code>use</code> 在渲染期间读取 Promise 或 Context 的值。传入 Promise 时，它会挂起（suspend）组件直到 Promise resolve（由最近的 <code>&lt;Suspense&gt;</code> 边界处理），然后返回 resolve 后的值。与 <code>useEffect</code> 不同，<code>use</code> 可以在条件语句和循环中调用，且 resolve 后的数据在挂起后同步可用，因此无需在组件树中传递 <code>loading</code> 状态。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { use, <span class="hljs-title class_">Suspense</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Profile</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ userPromise }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> user = <span class="hljs-title function_">use</span>(userPromise); <span class="hljs-comment">// suspends until resolved</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">h1</span>&gt;</span>{user.name}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">h1</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// Server Component: render runs once per request, so the promise is stable.</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// In a Client Component, create the promise outside render (or via `cache()`)</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// to avoid making a new one on every re-render.</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Page</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> userPromise = <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchUser</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fallback</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">p</span>&gt;</span>Loading...<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">p</span>&gt;</span>}&gt;
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Profile</span> <span class="hljs-attr">userPromise</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{userPromise}</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-122">106. 什么是 React Server Components？</h4>
<p>Server Components 在服务器上渲染，并将其输出流式传输到客户端。它们从不会向浏览器发送 JavaScript，可以直接 <code>await</code> 数据（无需 <code>useEffect</code> 往返），并可以访问仅限服务端的资源（如数据库或文件系统）。它们不能使用 <code>useState</code> 或 <code>useEffect</code> 等 hooks，不能附加事件处理程序，也不能使用仅限浏览器的 API；这些仍然属于 Client Components（标记为 <code>'use client'</code> 的文件）。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-123">107. Server Components 和 Client Components 有什么区别？</h4>








































<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Server Component</th><th>Client Component</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>运行位置</td><td>服务器（构建或请求时）</td><td>浏览器（hydration 后）</td></tr><tr><td>发送 JS</td><td>无</td><td>有</td></tr><tr><td>State / effects</td><td>不允许</td><td>允许</td></tr><tr><td>事件处理程序</td><td>不允许</td><td>允许</td></tr><tr><td>可直接 <code>await</code> 数据</td><td>是</td><td>否（使用 <code>use</code> 或在 effect 中 fetch）</td></tr><tr><td>可导入另一方</td><td>是（渲染 Client Components）</td><td>否（不能导入 Server Components，只能作为 props/children 接收）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>Server Components 通常是获取数据的外层外壳；Client Components 是标记有 <code>'use client'</code> 的交互式叶子节点。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-124">108. 什么是 React Compiler？</h4>
<p>React Compiler 是一个可选加入的构建时工具，它分析你的组件并在安全的地方自动插入等效于 <code>useMemo</code>、<code>useCallback</code> 和 <code>React.memo</code> 的 memoization。它在大多数情况下消除了手动 memoization 的需求。它严格强制执行 Rules of React：如果你的代码违反规则（如修改 props、条件调用 hooks），编译器会跳过该组件而非产生不正确的输出。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-125">109. <code>useTransition</code> 和 <code>useDeferredValue</code> 有什么区别？</h4>
<p>两者都将更新标记为非紧急，以便 React 保持 UI 响应。区别在于控制的位置：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>useTransition</code>：在调用点包装 state setter。由你决定某个特定更新何时应为 transition（如搜索提交）。</li>
<li><code>useDeferredValue</code>：在消费点包装一个值。它返回该值的一个滞后副本，在紧急渲染之后更新，适用于数据源不在你控制范围内的情况（如通过 props 传入的值）。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// useTransition: control at the dispatch site</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [isPending, startTransition] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTransition</span>();
<span class="hljs-title function_">startTransition</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setQuery</span>(input));

<span class="hljs-comment">// useDeferredValue: control at the read site</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> deferredQuery = <span class="hljs-title function_">useDeferredValue</span>(query);
<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ExpensiveResults</span> <span class="hljs-attr">query</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{deferredQuery}</span> /&gt;</span></span>;
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-126">110. React 19 中新的 <code>&lt;form action&gt;</code> prop 如何工作？</h4>
<p>React 19 允许你直接将函数传递给 <code>&lt;form action&gt;</code>（以及 <code>&lt;button formAction&gt;</code>）。当表单提交时，React 以 <code>FormData</code> 作为参数调用该函数，在 transition 中运行它，并在成功时重置非受控输入。将其与 <code>useActionState</code> 或 <code>useFormStatus</code> 结合使用，无需手动的 <code>onSubmit</code> 管道即可获得 pending 状态和错误处理。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useFormStatus } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react-dom'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">SubmitButton</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { pending } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useFormStatus</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">disabled</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{pending}</span>&gt;</span>{pending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'}<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">ProfileForm</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">save</span>(<span class="hljs-params">formData</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateProfile</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromEntries</span>(formData));
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">form</span> <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{save}</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">input</span> <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"name"</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">SubmitButton</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">form</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
